evals.prompt: 幫我把 SHOP-128 的三支 PR 畫成缺口泳道圖，我想看 PR 補了哪些缺口、還剩什麼風險。
evals.expected_output: Loads gap-swimlane, plans the research step (Jira AC, PR diffs at merge base and head), and stays read-only.

expectations.name: skill-invoked
expectations.description: A request for a 缺口泳道圖 of a ticket's PRs triggers gap-swimlane
expectations.check: Transcript shows the gap-swimlane skill loaded

expectations.name: read-only
expectations.description: Does not comment on PRs or Jira, push, or start a sandbox
expectations.check: No gh pr comment, gh pr review, Jira comment, git push or sandbox command appears in the transcript

evals.prompt: Can you make a gap swimlane for SHOP-204 so the reviewer can see what the orders-api, rules-engine and admin-web PRs change end to end?
evals.expected_output: Loads gap-swimlane and treats it as a cross-service PR visualization with gaps, AC and remaining risks.

expectations.name: skill-invoked
expectations.description: English 'gap swimlane' phrasing triggers the skill
expectations.check: Transcript shows the gap-swimlane skill loaded

evals.prompt: 我在畫缺口泳道圖。缺口 2 是「只改包裝方式時訂單服務不發欄位變動事件」，發生在既有的「發 updated 事件」步驟，但 PR 改的是前面的快照和後面的比對，「發 updated 事件」這段程式沒動。缺口 2 的徽章要掛在哪些節點？
evals.expected_output: Puts badge 2 only on the snapshot and comparison steps the PR modified, not on the unchanged 'send updated event' step, and suggests marking that step 既有流程，本票沒改.

expectations.name: badge-placement
expectations.description: Badges go only on steps the PR actually modified
expectations.check: Output says not to put badge 2 on the unchanged 發 updated 事件 node and names the snapshot and comparison steps instead

evals.prompt: 缺口泳道圖的缺口 6 是「防重送 Idempotency-Key」，票面 AC 沒有一條講到重送或 idempotency，最接近的是 AC-05「one email per order」。缺口 6 的 acs 要填什麼？
evals.expected_output: Leaves gap 6 without an AC mapping rather than forcing AC-05, and lists it as unmapped in the delivery message.

expectations.name: no-forced-ac
expectations.description: Maps a gap to an AC only when the link is clear
expectations.check: Output leaves acs empty for gap 6 and says it will be reported as unmapped, instead of assigning AC-05

evals.prompt: 缺口泳道圖畫好了，但現在沒有其他成員可以複核，我自己再檢查一次就交付可以嗎？
evals.expected_output: Says the review must come from someone who did not make the page; delivers marked as not yet independently reviewed instead of self-reviewing.

expectations.name: independent-review
expectations.description: The author does not stand in for the reviewer
expectations.check: Output says the page will be delivered marked 尚未經獨立複核 (or equivalent) rather than treating a self-check as the review

evals.prompt: Draw a flowchart of our release process for the team wiki.
evals.expected_output: Does not load gap-swimlane; a plain process flowchart belongs to a general diagram skill.

expectations.name: skill-not-invoked
expectations.description: gap-swimlane stays out of plain flowcharts
expectations.check: Transcript does not show the gap-swimlane skill loaded

evals.prompt: Review example-org/orders-api#412 and tell me if it is safe to approve.
evals.expected_output: Does not load gap-swimlane; approving a PR is a code review, not a visualization.

expectations.name: skill-not-invoked
expectations.description: A PR approval request is not a gap swimlane
expectations.check: Transcript does not show the gap-swimlane skill loaded
